name: Anubiznis
source:
One of the main characters of Copper Pancake Calcification.

The ancient Egyptian deity has now become the midlife crisis deity! Taking on a new thug persona to try to cover up how pathetic his life is. He knows this rouse is a lost cause and so is he.

But he be handlin' tha buziness!
